en: The postcard features a sepia-tone photograph of a grand building with a formal garden in the foreground, wide stone staircases, manicured hedges, and palm trees. The building is large, multi-storied, and has many windows and awnings, evocative of a historic spa or hotel. The lower left of the image has the printed name 'Bad Pyrmont', and the right has 'Kurhaus', indicating a historical spa house. The reverse side has German text and stamps, and a large blue logo for 'Museum im Schloss Bad Pyrmont'. There is also publishing information on the bottom left and typical postcard formatting.
